title: Bridging the gap: improving healthcare access for people with disabilities
discussion_signal: The video uses lived healthcare examples to show how physical, communication, and provider-understanding barriers can persist even when care formally exists. It frames access as the ability to receive appropriate treatment, not merely the presence of a service.
linked_research_question: How coverage, facilities, equipment, communication, provider assumptions, and accommodation combine to produce usable or unusable care.
limits: Advocacy and educational framing, not a representative sample
The video does not estimate barrier prevalence or causal health effects
Audience response and follow-up outcomes are not observed
